clue.text: Bag duck, say, and face criticism

definitions.meaning: to shoot and bag a duck is to obtain a bird, duck being one example
theatre slang for being hissed or booed by an audience

explanation.surface: A hunter shoots a duck and then gets a dressing-down for it.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally acquiring a feathered creature, and idiomatically being jeered or rejected, as an actor hissed off stage.

clue.text: Complain, unable to finish Marx

indicators.note: the comedian's first name cannot reach its end, so its final letter is lost

parts.note: Groucho Marx, the moustached comedian of the Marx Brothers

explanation.surface: A grumble about Karl Marx's unfinished work, perhaps Das Kapital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Marx' suggests Karl, but it is Groucho of the Marx Brothers; 'unable to finish' drops his final O.
explanation.definitionFit: To grumble or moan, used as a verb.

clue.text: His work should suit you

parts.note: read 'suit you' as making a suit to fit you, not as pleasing you

explanation.definitionFit: A clothier who makes made-to-measure suits and jackets.

clue.text: Unstable construction, so UFO crashed, alas

indicators.note: the cry of dismay over the wreck tells us the letters before it are jumbled into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written, as part of the pool of letters

explanation.surface: A flying saucer has come down in a heap, and that is the end of a shaky craft.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crashed' looks like the anagram signal but is fodder; 'alas' is the indicator, rearranging SO, UFO and CRASHED.
explanation.definitionFit: A tower of playing cards is a byword for anything flimsy that may collapse at a touch.

clue.text: Carried, without elaboration

definitions.meaning: an archaic past tense of bear, to carry

explanation.surface: Something was borne along with no fuss.
explanation.definitionFit: An old past tense of bear meaning conveyed, and an adjective meaning plain or unembellished.

clue.text: Recoil from lie in sincere horror

indicators.note: the word lie is placed inside the jumbled letters
the horrified state of the word sincere means its letters are thrown into disorder

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone honest shrinks away in horror from a falsehood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'horror' rearranges SINCERE to RESINCE, and 'in' sets LIE inside it, after RESI.
explanation.definitionFit: Recoil as a noun is springback, the elastic ability to return to shape.

clue.text: Threesome not lacking in patriotism

indicators.note: the word patriotism is not without the answer: it holds it among its letters

explanation.surface: A group of three people with plenty of love for their country.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of three, such as three musicians.

clue.text: Sound accurate, as Big Ben does?

definitions.meaning: Big Ben is the great bell in the clock tower at Westminster, London, and a bell rings; the clock is accurate

explanation.surface: Something seems right, just as London's famous clock bell keeps true time.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom for seeming believable, and literally a well-tuned bell chiming correctly.

clue.text: Finished journey, using manual control

parts.note: over means at an end
a ride is a trip on a horse or vehicle

explanation.surface: At the end of a trip, a driver takes the wheel by hand.
explanation.definitionFit: A noun for a device or means of taking charge in place of an automatic system.

clue.text: This writer should get his subject dead right

definitions.text: This writer should get his subject dead right

parts.words: This writer should get his subject dead right
parts.note: the writer's subject is literally dead: he composes death notices for newspapers

explanation.definitionFit: A journalist who writes pieces marking people's deaths.

clue.text: Working with the church in the past

parts.note: a machine that is on is working
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Someone who formerly worked for the church.
explanation.definitionFit: Formerly, at one time.

clue.text: Ate too much that was spoiled

definitions.meaning: pampered, as a child given everything it wants

explanation.surface: Someone gorged on food that had gone off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spoiled' reads as food gone bad, but means pampered.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally overeating, and figuratively pampered by excessive giving in.

clue.text: His employers have him over a barrel

definitions.text: His employers have him over a barrel

parts.words: His employers have him over a barrel
parts.note: 'over a barrel' usually means helpless, but here the worker literally bends over casks he makes

explanation.definitionFit: A craftsman who makes and repairs wooden casks and tubs.

clue.text: Curious to reveal what gives Americans a lift

indicators.note: curious in the sense of odd, so the letters of to reveal come out in a strange order

explanation.surface: Strange things are disclosed about what cheers up people in the USA.
explanation.definitionFit: The American word for what Britons call a lift, a car moving between floors.

clue.text: Make efficient course underwater

definitions.meaning: to simplify or organise for better performance
the path a fluid particle follows when water flows smoothly

explanation.surface: A swimmer refines a route beneath the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A verb for organising things more smoothly, and a noun in fluid dynamics for a flow path.

clue.text: Under way, with no visible means of support?

definitions.text: with no visible means of support?
definitions.meaning: literally hovering, not touching the earth

explanation.surface: Something has begun, though nothing seems to hold it up.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom for a scheme getting started, and literally aloft above the soil.

clue.text: Builders' platform once fatal to many

definitions.meaning: a temporary framework of poles and boards for workers
the platform for public executions by hanging or beheading

explanation.surface: Workers' staging that once killed a lot of people.
explanation.definitionFit: Construction staging, and the old gallows stage on which criminals were executed.

clue.text: Nice ears — awful to have wax

indicators.note: the ears look awful, so their letters, with nice, are jumbled

explanation.surface: Lovely ears made ugly by a build-up of earwax.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wax' looks like earwax, but it is the verb, as the moon waxes.
explanation.definitionFit: To wax is to grow larger, as the moon does.

clue.text: Evens-can colt fail for better?

indicators.note: the horse failing in the race signals that its letters, with evens-can, are rearranged

explanation.surface: A racing tip: can an evens-favourite colt fail, and is betting on it wise?
explanation.walkthrough: 'better' reads as a gambler; it is the adjective, recovering from illness. 'Evens' is betting odds of one to one.
explanation.definitionFit: Recovering health after illness, so getting well again.

clue.text: Came in to restore place of entertainment

indicators.note: the words came in are repaired or rebuilt into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone arrived to refurbish a theatre.
explanation.definitionFit: A picture house, where people go to watch films.

clue.text: Made watertight, to be conducted under ocean

indicators.note: in a down clue the piece for conducted is written below the piece for ocean

parts.note: the sea is an ocean
led means guided or conducted

explanation.surface: A vessel sealed against leaks, to be guided beneath the waves.
explanation.definitionFit: Closed up so that no water can leak in.

clue.text: Dismissed a Commons member, one gassy and explosive

parts.note: fired means sacked from a job
MP, Member of Parliament, sits in the House of Commons

explanation.surface: An MP is sacked for being a windbag who loses his temper.
explanation.definitionFit: Methane in coal mines, a gas liable to explode.

clue.text: Fast road laid in purple stone

indicators.note: the motorway is put down inside the colour word, as a road is laid

parts.note: puce is a purplish-brown colour
the M1 motorway, written MI, Britain's main north-south motorway

explanation.surface: A motorway is surfaced with purple stones.
explanation.definitionFit: A light volcanic rock used for scrubbing skin.

clue.text: Many in one car

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, a great many
taken as written
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Lots of people crammed into a single car.
explanation.definitionFit: A small British car, the Mini, famous for how many could squeeze in.

clue.text: Love girl with rounded shape

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, written O
Val is a girl's name, short for Valerie

explanation.surface: A girl's curvy figure inspires love.
explanation.definitionFit: An egg-like elliptical form.

clue.text: The sphere of the underwater explorer

definitions.text: The sphere of the underwater explorer

parts.words: The sphere of the underwater explorer
parts.note: sphere reads as field of activity, but it is a literal round chamber lowered into the sea

explanation.definitionFit: An open-bottomed chamber lowered into water, in which people can work beneath the surface.

clue.text: Two-piece?

parts.note: suggests a bikini or suit, but means a piece of music for a pair of performers

explanation.definitionFit: A composition written for a pair of singers or players.

clue.text: Where one may cough politely, say, being late?

definitions.text: Where one may cough politely, say
definitions.meaning: a polite cougher covers the mouth, so the cough is behind the palm

explanation.surface: A polite cougher covers their mouth while running late.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally at the back of one's palm, and an adjective meaning tardy or in arrears.
